title: Palisades (Holtec restart): OEDO-25-00290 2.206 Petition - Palisades Restart - Mr. Alan Blind - Petitioner Declined Public Meeting on the Initial Assessment (EPID L-2025-CRS-0000) [['2.206 Petition', 'E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:              Alan Blind
To:                Dennis Galvin
Cc:                Petition Resource
Subject:           [External_Sender] Re: Inquiry on Request for Meeting on Palisades Restart 2.206 Petition Initial Assessment
Date:              Tuesday, November 3, 2026 2:23:50 PM


Dennis

Thank your for your work to resolve my issues raised as you reference.

Your actions have resolved my concerns and there is no longer a no need for a public meeting.

Alan Blind

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 2:12 PM Dennis Galvin <Dennis.Galvin@nrc.gov> wrote:

  Dear Mr. Blind,



  On October 9, 2026 (ML26282B022), I transmitted to you the initial assessment for the
  petitions you submitted from May 15, 2025, to April 2, 2026, to the Nuclear Regulatory
  Commission (NRC) for consideration under Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations
  (10 CFR), Section 2.206. The submissions requested various enforcement actions
  against Holtec Decommissioning International, LLC, and Holtec Palisades, LLC
  (collectively Holtec) regarding the Palisades Nuclear Plant (PNP or Palisades).



  In the transmittal for the initial assessment, I offered you an opportunity to clarify your
  petition in a virtual public meeting with the petition review board. Please let me know
  your decision regarding the public meeting.



  If you have any questions regarding this e-mail, please feel free to contact me at

  Dennis.Galvin@nrc.gov or 301-415-6256.



  Respectfully,



  Dennis Galvin

  Project Manager / Agency 2.206 Petition Coordinator

  U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission

  Office of Nuclear Reactor Regulation
 Division of Licensing Projects I

Operating Reactor Licensing Branch 2

301-415-6256
